fullDescription: A standalone timeline COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: A vertical tick rail that magnifies toward the pointer, like a dock, driving a preview card. Every tick is one step. Magnification uses a gaussian falloff over about three ticks either side, and each tick eases toward its target every frame rather than snapping, which is what makes it feel physical. The crest tick drives a preview card with a progress bar and a timecode. Rotates to a horizontal rail under 680px. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.

style.description: Light shadcn section register: a near-white ground, white cards, 1px hairline borders, 12 to 16px radii, one indigo accent, and Inter at 400 to 700. No shadows beyond a 1px lift, no gradients used as decoration, no photography.
style.prompt: Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

prompts.prompt: Every tick is one step. Magnification uses a gaussian falloff over about three ticks either side, and each tick eases toward its target every frame rather than snapping, which is what makes it feel physical. The crest tick drives a preview card with a progress bar and a timecode. Rotates to a horizontal rail under 680px.
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.
